title: don't mutate attributes on get(), have it work for collections as well

labels.name: big job

body:
**Problem:**
1-to-many (e.g., "videos" below) fields of transient/detached objects automatically load empty lists as values after they've been accessed. As shown in the example below, an unbound user object gets created. The first set of asserts show that none of the fields have values loaded, except for `first_name`. After we access the fields through print statements, the last test fails because `mapper.attrs.videos.loaded_value == []`. I would expect videos' value to remain unloaded after the print statement. 

This could lead to problems… for example, if you access a transient object's 1-to-many field, merge the object (using session.merge(obj)) and commit,  the existing relationship values, if exist, gets replaced with an empty list, thus removes the children.

```python
def test_sqlalchemy_loaded_relationships():
    import sqlalchemy as sa
    from sqlalchemy.orm.base import NO_VALUE
    from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
    Base = declarative_base()

    class User(Base):
        __tablename__ = 'user'

        id = sa.Column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)
        first_name = sa.Column(sa.Text)
        last_name = sa.Column(sa.Text)
        profile = sa.orm.relationship(
            'Profile',
            uselist=False,
            single_parent=True,
            cascade='all, delete-orphan',
        )
        videos = sa.orm.relationship(
            'Video',
            cascade='all, delete-orphan',
        )

    class Profile(Base):
        __tablename__ = 'profile'

        id = sa.Column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)
        phone_number = sa.Column(sa.Text)
        user_id = sa.Column(
            sa.dialects.postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True),
            sa.ForeignKey('user.id', name='fk_profile_user_id'),
            nullable=False,
        )

    class Video(Base):
        __tablename__ = 'video'

        id = sa.Column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)
        name = sa.Column(sa.Text)
        url = sa.Column(sa.Text)
        user_id = sa.Column(
            sa.dialects.postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True),
            sa.ForeignKey('user.id', name='fk_video_user_id'),
            nullable=False,
        )

    john = User(first_name='John')

    # values are not loaded
    mapper = sa.inspect(john)
    assert mapper.attrs.first_name.loaded_value == 'John'
    assert mapper.attrs.last_name.loaded_value == NO_VALUE
    assert mapper.attrs.profile.loaded_value == NO_VALUE
    assert mapper.attrs.videos.loaded_value == NO_VALUE

    # when values are accessed, videos values gets loaded to empty list
    print(john.first_name)  # John
    print(john.last_name)   # None
    print(john.profile)     # None
    print(john.videos)      # []

    assert mapper.attrs.first_name.loaded_value == 'John'
    assert mapper.attrs.last_name.loaded_value == NO_VALUE
    assert mapper.attrs.profile.loaded_value == NO_VALUE
    assert mapper.attrs.videos.loaded_value == NO_VALUE  # FAILS!`
